meta_state_law_citations_007.answer: PSP is initiated when a PAR mentor, after meeting with the teacher's PDP Team/ or Guided PDP team, determines the need to assure additional support for the teachers (as defined by MN Statute §179.A.03, Subd. 18) to achieve the necessary goals and objectives.
